questions.explanation: Outbreaks occur in the meningitis belt of Africa, which includes the northern states of Nigeria, in the dry season.

questions.explanation: Chlamydiae cannot make their own ATP and grow only in host cells. Trachoma is a leading infectious cause of blindness.
